description: Get complete schema.org entity data by URL (its @id), including relationships the graph holds in either direction. Use this before selecting an entity's image or other media: retain the canonical subject ID and use only assets explicitly linked by the retrieved record. A matching name, caption or filename alone does not establish identity. If no supported asset is available, state the limitation; do not add externally searched media to a KG-grounded answer.
name: get_entity
